model.summary: Model favors MIN by 7.2 points (70% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (MIN +3.4), Rest days (home minus away) (ATL +1.7), Quarterback rating (MIN +1.2). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 44.0 total points (MIN 26, ATL 18). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.7), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (lowers total 1.3), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 1.1). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
